title: Enriched exponentials descend coherently to the nerve
statement:
Work in nested universes large enough for the following objects, and use locally Kan simplicial categories and the homotopy coherent nerve as in [def-coef-coherent-nerve-infrastructure], coherent mapping spaces as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and coherent adjunctions as in [def-coef-coherent-adjunction-data]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a simplicial category all of whose mapping simplicial sets $\mathcal A(U,V)$ are Kan complexes. Suppose its underlying ordinary category has chosen terminal object $1$, binary products with projections, and for every $X,Y$ a chosen object $E(X,Y)$ with evaluation $e_{X,Y}:E(X,Y)\times X\to Y$. Suppose the projection maps induce isomorphisms of simplicial sets
$$\mathcal A(T,1)\cong\Delta^0,\qquad\mathcal A(T,U\times V)\cong\mathcal A(T,U)\times\mathcal A(T,V),$$
and that product with $X$ followed by composition with this actual evaluation induces an isomorphism of simplicial sets
$$\mathcal A(T,E(X,Y))\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal A(T\times X,Y)$$
for every $T,X,Y$. Then the chosen product and exponential assignments extend to simplicial enriched functors $\mathcal A\times\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ and $E:\mathcal A^{\mathrm{op}}\times\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ with enriched natural evaluation, and the displayed exponential isomorphisms are enriched natural in all three variables. For enriched morphisms $u:X'\to X$ and $v:Y\to Y'$, the action $E(u,v)$ is the transpose of $v\circ e_{X,Y}\circ(1\times u)$; in each simplicial degree the common parameter is shared by its diagonal. The coherent nerve $N_{\mathrm{hc}}\mathcal A$ has the indicated terminal object and products and, for every $X$, $N_{\mathrm{hc}}E(X,-)$ is a coherent right adjoint to product with $X$. Its counit is the image of $e_{X,Y}$ and its mapping-space adjunction is
$$\operatorname{Map}(T,E(X,Y))\simeq\operatorname{Map}(T\times X,Y),$$
induced by evaluation and composition, coherently natural in $T,X,Y$. In particular this asserts an adjunction of coherent functors, retaining higher homotopies, rather than only an adjunction of ordinary homotopy categories.

source.place: Kerodon Remark 7.7.3.9 (Tag 05UP), conditions (1)-(3) and conclusion; enriched action and its naturality make explicit the exponential universal property used there. This is a Kerodon tag, not a Stacks tag. Read online; archival copy WANTED.
